profileText: a Representative from Texas; born in Brownsville, Cameron County, Tex., November 11, 1974; graduated from James Pace High School, Brownsville, Tex.; B.B.A., University of Texas, San Antonio, Tex., 1997; business owner; insurance agent; unsuccessful candidate for election to the One Hundred Seventeenth Congress in 2020; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Eighteenth and to the succeeding Congress (January 3, 2023-present).
